text:
maria_cs: Quick Arcadia weekly health check — attaching p95/p99 snapshot by route + model and streaming vs non-stream. Trial ends in ~3w, flagging for renewal context.

deploy-bot: snapshot uploaded: https://files.redwood/internal/arcadia/1716001234/health-snapshot.png

oliver_sre: Pulled tail numbers from 24h window (UTC):
- /chat (redwood-alpha-1) streaming: p95=420ms p99=1.9s
- /chat (redwood-alpha-1) non-stream: p95=590ms p99=2.7s
- /generate (rw-4o-quant) streaming: p95=360ms p99=1.3s
- /generate (rw-4o-quant) non-stream: p95=480ms p99=1.8s
- /embed (rw-embed-2) (non-stream only): p95=120ms p99=450ms

sam_engineer: Observed pattern: p95s improve when continuous batching is on, but p99 spikes correlate with fallback to cpu-quant path during capacity pressure. Small bursts at ~03:00 UTC.

kevin_research: Error-rate note: transient increase to ~0.9% coincident with the longest tails; traces show KV-cache misses + model fallback events.

maria_cs: Good context. Arcadia wants consistency on 99th — what quick mitigations can we propose before renewal conversation?

oliver_sre: Short-term suggestions: 1) pin critical route (/chat) to rw-4o-quant for this account, 2) enable prefix/KV caching for their 3 most common prompts, 3) add canary window to prevent rollouts during their peak hours.

sam_engineer: I can schedule the config changes tomorrow 09:00 PT and run a 24h tail-check. Will post diffs and raw traces.

maria_cs: Please add those items to the enablement checklist and the renewal playbook note. I'll tell Arcadia we're executing fixes.

kevin_research: I'm also pushing a tiny KV-cache telemetry patch to show misses in the console (ETA ~48h) so CS can surface live evidence in the renewal call.

maria_cs: Perfect — thanks everyone. Once we have the 24h re-run, I'll update the account scoring and renewal risk. :thumbsup:

sam_engineer: will post after the run with before/after p95/p99 and a short command snippet for ops: `redwoodctl account-config set arcadia --route /chat --model rw-4o-quant --enable-prefix-cache true`

oliver_sre: Also adding a note to incidents: if p99 > 2s for >1h, auto-escalate to oncall-for-runtime.

maria_cs: Copy. I'll follow up with Arcadia on Monday.
